## Patched versions

1.7.1

## Description

### Impact

Stack-buffer-overflow; jq 1.7 builds using decNumber.  
 Reproduce with

```
'1 != .' ' '<<< Nan4000
```

oss-fuzz Recommended Security Severity: High

### Patches

Allocate `decNumberUnit` to perform the comparison without overflow.

### Workarounds

Upgrade to 1.7.1
